d: Turki ki sansad men jald hi makka samjhaute ko lekar voting hogi. turki, pakistan aur saoodi arab ke bich ye raksha samjhauta men agast men huaa tha. saoodi arab par hutiyon ke hamle ke bich turki makka samjhaute ke tahat saoodi ki madad karna chahta hai. halanki, iske lie pahle turki ki sansad se makka samjhaute ko manzuri milna zaruri hai. riports ke mutabik, is haphte sansad ki janral asenbli men is par charcha hogi, jiske bad sansad is par vot karenge.
